05-14-1568 is May 14, 1568.  
10 weeks = 70 days.  
Add 7 more days → total 77 days.  
May 14 + 77 days: May has 31 days, so May 14 → May 31 is 17 days.  
Remaining: 77 - 17 = 60 days.  
June 1568 has 30 days → after June 30, 60 - 30 = 30 days left.  
July 1568 has 31 days → July 31 is 31 days later, but we only need 30 days into July → July 30, 1568.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1568-07-30
